The source places Lovable last. The approved event layout puts Lovable first, followed by Aikido and incident.io in their original order, and fits the headline across two lines on the 600 × 400 canvas. It preserves the event details and uses the original Lovable gradient.

Rebuilt at 600 × 400 with Camera Plain and Lovable first. Text, logos and artwork are editable.
